frameworks.odd: Organic-Driven Development (Adaptive real-time telemetry and domain feedback)

architecture_layer: Full-Stack Training Optimization Pipeline (FastAPI PyTorch Service & Next.js React UI)
summary: Implementación desacoplada y tipada de la sintonización del optimizador AdamW (Weight Decay L2) de punta a punta, permitiendo la adaptación precisa a cualquier tamaño y tipo de dataset sin sobre-ingeniería.

verified_endpoints.purpose: Launch decoupled training background thread with configured AdamW weight_decay

odd_observability_features: Structured log emitted on PyTorch initialization: [INFO] Optimizador AdamW configurado: lr={lr}, weight_decay={weight_decay}
UI state weightDecay bound to responsive 4-column hyperparameter grid with clear AdamW L2 regularización label
Architecture presets dynamically update recommended weight decay (0.01 for EfficientNet/ResNet, 0.05 for ConvNeXt-Nano, 0.001 for AudioCNN)
